Restaurant Manager for Indian Restaurant

Pippali Indian Grill is looking for an experienced Restaurant Manager!

Pippali Indian Grill is an Indian restaurant serving authentic Indian food with a focus on quality, flavour, hospitality and traditional cooking culture. We are looking for a responsible and experienced Restaurant Manager to help manage the daily operations of the restaurant and ensure a high standard of service, organisation and guest experience.

As our Restaurant Manager, you will be responsible for the daily coordination of the restaurant, including staff planning, customer service, communication between the kitchen and front-of-house, purchasing, quality control and general operational management. You will play an important role in ensuring that the restaurant runs efficiently and professionally every day.

Your main tasks will include:
Managing and coordinating the daily restaurant operations
Planning staff schedules and assigning daily tasks
Supervising and supporting kitchen and service staff
Ensuring a high level of customer service and guest satisfaction
Handling customer enquiries, feedback and complaints professionally
Coordinating communication between kitchen staff and front-of-house staff
Assisting with purchasing, stock control and supplier coordination
Ensuring compliance with hygiene, food safety and workplace procedures
Helping maintain quality, efficiency and consistency in restaurant operations
Supporting management with administrative and operational tasks
Training and guiding new employees when needed

We expect that you:
Have relevant education in hospitality, restaurant management, business or a related field, or equivalent documented professional experience
Have experience from the restaurant, hospitality or food service industry
Have experience with staff coordination, planning and daily operations
Can work independently and take responsibility for running daily restaurant tasks
Have good communication and organisational skills
Are service-minded, reliable, flexible and solution-oriented
Can handle a busy restaurant environment and make decisions under pressure
Have knowledge of hygiene, food safety and restaurant service standards
Can communicate in English. Danish is an advantage but not required.
Knowledge of Indian food culture, Indian cuisine or Indian restaurant operations is an advantage.

Documentation of qualifications

Applicants should be able to document their professional background through relevant certificates, diplomas, employment references, recommendation letters, previous employment records or other documentation showing education and/or practical experience in restaurant management, hospitality, business operations or staff coordination.

We offer:
A full-time position in an Indian restaurant
A responsible role with influence on daily operations
A workplace with focus on authentic food, quality and good service
A friendly and professional working environment
The opportunity to use your management experience in the Danish restaurant industry
Salary according to qualifications and agreement
Employment terms according to Danish standards

Please write in the subject field that you are applying for the manager position. We look forward to hearing from you!

North Indian Cook for Indian Restaurant

Pippali Indian Grill is looking for an experienced North Indian Cook

Pippali Indian Grill is an Indian restaurant serving authentic Indian food with a focus on quality, flavour and traditional cooking methods. We are looking for a skilled and reliable cook with experience in North Indian cuisine to join our kitchen team.

As our new cook, you will be responsible for preparing and cooking Indian dishes, especially North Indian specialities such as curries, tandoori dishes, marinades, sauces, biryani and traditional vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes. You will help ensure that our food is prepared consistently, hygienically and to a high standard.

Your main tasks will include:
Preparing and cooking authentic North Indian dishes
Preparing marinades, sauces, curries and spice mixes
Working with tandoor, grill and traditional Indian cooking techniques
Ensuring good food quality, taste and presentation
Maintaining hygiene and food safety standards in the kitchen
Helping with daily kitchen preparation and cleaning
Cooperating with the rest of the kitchen and restaurant team

We expect that you:
Have relevant culinary education or equivalent documented professional experience as a cook
Have experience with North Indian cuisine, preferably from an Indian restaurant kitchen
Have strong knowledge of Indian spices, ingredients, marinades and traditional cooking methods
Can prepare North Indian dishes independently and consistently
Can work with tandoor, grill, curry preparation and other Indian kitchen techniques
Can work independently and handle a busy kitchen environment
Are reliable, flexible and quality-conscious
Can follow hygiene and food safety procedures
Can communicate in English. Danish is an advantage but not required.

Documentation of qualifications
Applicants should be able to document their professional background through relevant certificates, employment references, recommendation letters, previous employment records or other documentation showing education and/or practical experience as a cook.

We offer:
A full-time position in an Indian restaurant
A workplace with focus on authentic food and good service
A friendly and professional working environment
The opportunity to use your experience with Indian cuisine in Denmark
Salary according to qualifications and agreement
Employment terms according to Danish standards

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard (220m long, 9m high, 45m wide) and 10 special elements (38m long, 12,5m high, 50m wide) will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark.

To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Execute the TE systems works whilst coordinating closely and effectively with the involved (internal) stakeholders to optimize efficiency.

Plan, execute and register maintenance & repairs to the TE systems equipment:

o Pumps / Piping / Valves

o Electrical components

o Subsea sensors

o Hydraulic cylinders / Powerpacks / manifolds

o Umbilical winches / Sliprings

o Rolling equipment

Thereby ensuring operational equipment in compliance with legislative-, safety- and user requirements.

You will lead the team of technicians installing, maintaining and repairing the Tunnel Elements systems during the preparation, transport and installation phase of Tunnel Elements. Understand the functionality of the Tunnel Element systems. Troubleshoot system during installation and operation. Maintain and organize the work area (workshop and yard facilities) to ensure an orderly and safe workplace in compliance with Danish regulation, company procedures, and good work practice. Set up, select and support the TE systems team of technicians to ensure effective and reliable production cycle.

In the role of the Mechanical Supervisor, there will be interface with subcontractors, Operational departments of various disciplines and operations staff.

Qualifications:

The TE systems Mechanical Supervisor:

- Has the ability to read and understand technical drawings, working methods and working procedures.

- Plans the work ahead.

- Manages daily interface with other TE outfitting parties.

- Communicates in English (minimum B2 level) both written and spoken.

- Optimizes the usage of the TE systems team capabilities.

- Supports and coaches the TE systems technicians.

- Has excellent interpersonal skills

- Organizes daily toolbox / pre-start meetings.

- Connects the tasks to the bigger picture.

- Provides support and input on risk assessments for TE mobilization / demobilization, general tasks.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company. 

FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to The Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension health insurance and lunch arrangement will be available.

Rødbyhavn Denmark

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The FLC Survey Department plays a key role in supporting the construction of this immersed tunnel project. The marine survey team delivers positioning, navigation, monitoring, and hydrographic survey services for offshore construction activities using advanced technologies such as multibeam echo sounders, Inertial Navigation systems, LBL and USBL systems, Fibre Optic Gyroscopes and many more. Together with over 60 hydrographic and topographic survey professionals from more than 15 countries, the department ensures accurate survey data for all project phases. The topographic survey teams support construction through stake-out, control, and as-built surveys, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment including Total Stations, GNSS, drones, laser scanners, and specialist software for planning, execution, and data processing.

Within the marine survey team, the Positioning Specialists play a key role in the immersion of tunnel elements. They install, configure and operate advanced positioning systems, combining GNSS, INS, LBL, tautwire, and distance sensor technologies to ensure the precise placement of tunnel elements.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Prepare positioning systems for (re-)installation operations by performing maintenance, calibration, and configuration of the hard- and software.

Configure positioning software in preparation for positioning operations, such as Qinsy, Delph SP and Delph INS and project specific software.

Operate and monitor the positioning systems during tunnel element installation operations, such as GNSS (Septentrio), INS (Exail), LBL (Exail), SVP (AML) and a project specific Light Tautwire and Distance Sensor system.

Remote or on-board troubleshooting of positioning system issues.

Analyse positioning data of tunnel installation process.

jobs.occupation: Nuclear Quality Assurance Engineer, INB - French basic nuclear installation
jobs.description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

The ILL's Quality, Risk Management and Nuclear Safety Unit (CQSR - Cellule Qualité Sûreté Risques) is a small, dynamic team of five people which reports directly to ILL Management. The core mission of the CQSR is to maintain and improve the ILL's Integrated Management System (IMS), which enables the Institute to comply with regulatory requirements for basic nuclear installations (INB - Installation nucléaire de base). This includes aspects relating to nuclear safety and quality management.

Your tasks:
As quality assurance engineer, you will play an active part in the development and maintenance of the IMS. Your main duties will be to:
- Manage the process for monitoring fulfilment of commitments (improvement actions)
- Manage the process for monitoring regulatory changes and compliance
- Propose solutions to help process managers maintain and improve their processes
- Support engineers and technicians with the documentation requirements associated with technical projects to upgrade the facility
- Participate in IMS process reviews
- Help to lead training sessions on the IMS
- Prepare and conduct internal and external quality audits (including field work) on IMS processes

Once you have received training:
- Take on the role of contact person for corruption prevention and fraud control officer (information gathering, awareness-raising, whistleblowing contact person)
- Perform event analyses from an HOF perspective
- Assist with the preparation of the periodic information campaign on industrial hazards

Your profile:
- Master's degree (or equivalent) in quality assurance or Master's degree in general engineering with proven experience in quality assurance.
- Solid professional experience is required.
- Experience in the nuclear sector is required.
- Proficiency in the use of MS Office applications (PowerPoint, Excel, etc.).
- Excellent writing skills in French.
- Well-organised and methodical with a responsive attitude; good teamwork skills.

What we offer: 
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal by 25/10/2026, quoting reference number 26/44. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks) and that medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required for this position. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.
